plan.vw_project_plan_capex.label: Row
plan.vw_project_plan_capex.description: Row ordinal in the source extract. Positional only; it is not a business key and it does not survive a re-sort of the file.

plan.vw_project_plan_capex.label: Project Code
plan.vw_project_plan_capex.description: Project code, the primary business key for a capital project. Two shapes are in use: a discrete code (C24B535_651) and a blanket code (CZZF50310_658). The trailing segment after the underscore is the business-unit number.

plan.vw_project_plan_capex.label: Project Description
plan.vw_project_plan_capex.description: Free-text project description. Convention is project code, a site abbreviation and a short scope phrase. Human-authored, so the convention is followed but not enforced.

plan.vw_project_plan_capex.label: Region
plan.vw_project_plan_capex.description: Operating region. Four operating regions plus Shared Services Division, which is an organisational bucket rather than a geography and carries the sentinel state No State.

plan.vw_project_plan_capex.label: Business Unit
plan.vw_project_plan_capex.description: Business unit, formatted as BU number, a hyphen and the BU name. Each business unit belongs to exactly one region.

plan.vw_project_plan_capex.label: State
plan.vw_project_plan_capex.description: State. Each region maps to exactly one state. No State is a sentinel carried by Shared Services Division, not a missing value.

plan.vw_project_plan_capex.label: Budget Category
plan.vw_project_plan_capex.description: Budget category, the finance-side classification of the project. Six values in this extract, drawn from the attribute master's fifteen. Maps one-to-one to Program Affiliation, Budget Category 2 and High-Level Category.

plan.vw_project_plan_capex.label: Program Affiliation
plan.vw_project_plan_capex.description: Programme affiliation. Derived from Budget Category: PFAS maps to Federal PFAS Program, Lead maps to Lead Program, everything else to No program affiliation.

plan.vw_project_plan_capex.label: Asset Class
plan.vw_project_plan_capex.description: Asset class. Water Treatment, Water Network, Water Customer service lines, Overheads.

plan.vw_project_plan_capex.label: Project Manager
plan.vw_project_plan_capex.description: Project manager, as a person name. The source system carries two naming conventions in the same column - First Last and Last,First - and both appear here.

plan.vw_project_plan_capex.label: In_Phase
plan.vw_project_plan_capex.description: Delivery phase. In Planning, In Development, In Delivery. Agrees with Project Status at column 175.

plan.vw_project_plan_capex.label: WIN Approval Level
plan.vw_project_plan_capex.description: WIN approval level, Level 01 through Level 05. Populated only where the project has been through a WIN meeting.

plan.vw_project_plan_capex.label: WIN Approval Date
plan.vw_project_plan_capex.description: Date of the WIN approval meeting.

plan.vw_project_plan_capex.label: WIN Meeting Type
plan.vw_project_plan_capex.description: Meeting type for the WIN approval. Single-valued in this extract - every populated row reads Win Meeting - so the column carries no information beyond the fact of approval.

plan.vw_project_plan_capex.label: Start Date
plan.vw_project_plan_capex.description: Original project start date, as first planned.

plan.vw_project_plan_capex.label: Start Date (Adjusted)
plan.vw_project_plan_capex.description: Adjusted start date, where a re-baseline moved the start. Sparse, and the populated values cluster on three dates including the 1950-12-31 sentinel.

plan.vw_project_plan_capex.label: End Date
plan.vw_project_plan_capex.description: Original project end date. Year-end dated, so the distinct count is small.

plan.vw_project_plan_capex.label: End Date (Adjusted)
plan.vw_project_plan_capex.description: Adjusted end date, where a re-baseline moved the finish.

plan.vw_project_plan_capex.label: Estimated In Service Date
plan.vw_project_plan_capex.description: Estimated in-service date - when the asset is expected to go into service and begin depreciating. The regulatory hinge: an asset not in service is not in rate base.

plan.vw_project_plan_capex.label: Active Budget Plan
plan.vw_project_plan_capex.description: Active budget plan - the approved amount currently in force for the project. In the source this is the plan row whose status is Active, selected from a version chain by most recent approval date.

plan.vw_project_plan_capex.label: Most Recent Budget Plan
plan.vw_project_plan_capex.description: Most recent budget plan - the latest plan row in the chain, whether or not it is the one in force. Differs from Active Budget Plan wherever a newer plan has been submitted but not yet approved.

plan.vw_project_plan_capex.label: Budget Plan Status
plan.vw_project_plan_capex.description: Status of the budget plan row: Active or Inactive.

docs.document_corpus.description: EJCDC standard form number: C-520 and C-521 for construction agreements, E-500 for engineering agreements. Null on scope documents and on the non-standard agreements.

docs.document_corpus.label: contract_number
docs.document_corpus.description: Contract number. Prefix identifies the project, C or E identifies the discipline, and the sequence is per project.

docs.document_corpus.label: counterparty_contractor
docs.document_corpus.description: Contracting firm named as Contractor in the agreement. Twenty distinct firms across the corpus.

docs.document_corpus.label: counterparty_engineer
docs.document_corpus.description: Engineering firm named as Engineer in the agreement. Null where the document names no engineer.

docs.document_corpus.label: effective_date
docs.document_corpus.description: Effective date of the agreement, as printed. Stored in the source as a formatted string rather than a date.

docs.document_corpus.label: notice_to_proceed_date
docs.document_corpus.description: Notice-to-proceed date. Null on 61% of the corpus — the notice is a separate document that may not be filed with the agreement.

docs.document_corpus.label: contract_price_at_award
docs.document_corpus.description: Contract price as awarded — the committed amount at execution, before any change order.

docs.document_corpus.label: contract_price_as_adjusted
docs.document_corpus.description: Contract price as adjusted — the awarded price plus every executed change order. This is the figure that should be compared to a budget, and it is not the one printed on the first page.

docs.document_corpus.label: change_order_count
docs.document_corpus.description: Number of executed change orders found against the contract. Zero on scope documents and on contracts with no changes.

docs.document_corpus.label: project_manager_name
docs.document_corpus.description: Project manager named on the document, with title and organisation. A person name in a document body.

docs.document_corpus.label: business_unit_line
docs.document_corpus.description: Business unit line as printed — BU number, name, region and state. Two punctuation variants of the same line appear in the corpus.

docs.document_corpus.label: page_count
docs.document_corpus.description: Page count of the document as filed.

docs.document_corpus.label: is_scope_document
docs.document_corpus.description: Whether the document is a project scope document rather than an executed contract. Five of the thirty-six.

docs.document_corpus.label: active_budget_plan_stated
docs.document_corpus.description: Active budget plan as printed on the scope document. Present only on scope documents.

docs.document_corpus.label: most_recent_budget_plan_stated
docs.document_corpus.description: Most recent budget plan as printed on the scope document.

docs.document_corpus.label: value_under_contract_stated
docs.document_corpus.description: Total value under contract as printed on the scope document, across all contracts for the project.

docs.document_corpus.label: signature_block_names
docs.document_corpus.description: Names appearing in the execution and signature blocks — owner signatory, contractor signatory and witness.

docs.document_corpus.label: scope_text
docs.document_corpus.description: Full extracted body text of the scope document. Present on scope documents only.

docs.document_corpus.label: folder_name
docs.document_corpus.description: Drive folder name — project code, a space-hyphen-space and the project name. The folder convention is what carries the project association.

docs.document_corpus.label: extraction_confidence
docs.document_corpus.description: Confidence that the contract entity extracted from this document is correct. The lowest extraction confidence in the graph.
